subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: derro count
fact: A single Derro stands over a pit with an unbelievable smell emanating from it.
source_quote: a single Derro standing over a pit, with an unbelievable smell emanating from it

subject: demogorgon amulet value
fact: The amulet of Demogorgon is worn by the Derro as a symbol of devotion.
source_quote: he’s got an amulet of Demogorgon

subject: pit of Ulnara
fact: The pit is filled with body parts and reeks of death and decomposed flesh.
source_quote: tossing body parts over the ledge into the pit

subject: cage chamber
fact: Cages assembled from scrap iron line the chamber, with Derro speaking of the prince's hunger.
source_quote: cages assembled from scrap iron on both sides of the chamber

subject: ritual cavern
fact: A glowing ritual circle dominates a 5-foot-high platform, surrounded by books on Demogorgon and Derro madness.
source_quote: a glowing ritual circle dominates the top of the platform... books made from Trillimac

subject: trillimac book titles
fact: Books include 'The Spiraling Descent: A Treatise on Duality and Madness,' 'The Prince's Gift: On the Creation of Favored Spawn,' and 'Rituals of the Two-Headed Beast.'
source_quote: The Spiraling Descent: A Treatise on Duality and Madness... Rituals of the Two-Headed Beast

subject: narrak's experiment
fact: Narrak conducts experiments to elevate the Derro, triumph Demogorgon, and destroy the Duergar.
source_quote: We are conducting experiments!... The elevation of the Derro, the Triumph of Demogorgon, and the destruction of the Duergar!

subject: derro patrol
fact: A Derro patrol stumbles upon the party, displaying fear and derangement.
source_quote: a Derro patrol stumbles on us

subject: grygum's worship declaration
fact: Grygum declares worship of Bahamut, triggering immediate Derro hostility.
source_quote: I worship Bahamut!

subject: cave entrance with brimstone smell
fact: The cave entrance reeks of brimstone and chemicals, signaling a demonic presence.
source_quote: the unspeakable stench... smell of brimstone and chemicals

subject: death dogs
fact: Death dogs are present alongside Derro in the ritual cavern.
source_quote: some Derro and Death dogs

subject: derro papers
fact: Papers among the books contain evidence of Demogorgon's influence, sufficient to convince Errde Blackstaff.
source_quote: amongst the books are various papers... enough evidence to convince Errde of whatever she wants

subject: daz's spellcasting
fact: Daz casts Maximillian’s Earthen Grasp, Toll the Dead, and Magic Missile against Derro.
source_quote: I cast Maximillian’s Earthen Grasp... I cast Toll the Dead... launched his magic missiles

subject: grygum's combat actions
fact: Grygum is struck by Derro, defended by allies, and survives combat with divine protection.
source_quote: The other landed a hit on Grygum... our allies were quick to retaliate

subject: skiit
fact: Skiit, a Derro cultist of Demogorgon, is thrown into the pit and later resurrected as a zombie.
source_quote: Skiit looks at me and then points at Spiderbait... I push him over the cliff... turn him into a zombie

subject: ulnara's laboratory
fact: Ulnara, a Derro necromancer and Demogorgon cultist, oversees the creation of undead from pit offerings.
source_quote: Ulnara... necromancer in charge... cultist of Demogorgon... turn him into a zombie

subject: thorin's eastward decision
fact: Thorin chooses 'East' as the path forward, ending a debate and guiding the party's direction.
source_quote: I say - 'East.'

subject: zalthir's silent observation
fact: Zalthir observes all without speaking, acting with clarity and purpose.
source_quote: I observe everything and say nothing. My mind is clear. I act without speaking. I do because I know.

subject: grygum's divine scrutiny
fact: Grygum frames the question 'Who do you work for?' as a Divine Scrutiny, invoking Celestial Archives and Divine Ledgers.
source_quote: It is, in fact, a Divine Scrutiny, a profound act of investigation into the very threads of our intertwined fates... Divine Ledgers or Celestial Archives

subject: narrak
fact: Narrak, a Derro with warped intellect, leads experiments in service to Demogorgon.
source_quote: This is Narrak... his eyes dart about with a frenetic, almost desperate energy... warped intellect simmering beneath his frantic movements

subject: derro chant
fact: The Derro chant: 'For what purpose!' and 'The elevation of the Derro, the Triumph of Demogorgon, and the destruction of the Duergar!'
source_quote: For what purpose!... The elevation of the Derro, the Triumph of Demogorgon, and the destruction of the Duergar!

subject: derro madness
fact: Derro are described as former slaves of mind flayers, corrupted until barely dwarves, and irredeemably insane.
source_quote: The Derro themselves were predictably clumsy... Dwarves that were slaves of the mindflayers, who corrupted their fundamental nature until they are barely Dwarves. They are mad.
